scope: Additive MIN-NO Week 5 activation, value and replacement correction. This supersedes only the erroneous Yurosek-registry and Ford/Styles/Broughton/Shepherd status findings in the 2026-10-14 MIN-NO gamebook bundle. It preserves that bundle's final, frozen kickoff ratings, H4 and literal injury timing. Supported individual estimates remain CASE_ESTIMATE_ONLY until complete paired coverage passes the evaluator; no rating, active manifest, current-week overlay, fair or betting output is changed.

sources.finding: Official gamebook confirms the 23-13 final, Hockenson's Q1 14:22 injury and no return, Aaron Jones's bounded absence and explicit Q2 8:18 return, all final inactives, Ford and Styles active participation, and the exact snap inventory used only for role/candidate verification.

Official postgame report states Bartholomew stepped in when Hockenson suffered the concussion and that Bartholomew and activated Yurosek contributed in the absence of Hockenson and Josh Oliver; it also identifies the Darrisaw/Van Demark and Jackson/Huber line replacements and Addison's absence.
Official depth chart lists Bartholomew directly behind Hockenson, Felton as an active receiver reserve, and Claiborne/Dallas behind Aaron Jones after Mason's reserve placement.
Minnesota activated Ben Yurosek from Reserve/Injured on October 10; the final gamebook confirms he played 39 offensive snaps.
Official Madden NFL 27 launch rating binds Benjamin Yurosek, EA ID 4665, TE, Minnesota, OVR 62. The pinned calibration maps OVR 0-71 to 0.0 Walters points, matching the frozen Minnesota shard.
New Orleans activated Jaylan Ford and Lorenzo Styles Jr. from Reserve/Injured on October 10 and added Nathan Shepherd and Vernon Broughton to the game-status report as questionable with illness.
Final inactives include Jennings, Elliss, Wright, Broughton and Shepherd; Ford and Styles are absent from the inactive list and the gamebook confirms both played.

Official depth establishes Stutsman behind Elliss and the active edge/interior defensive-line candidate chains. The final gamebook confirms Stutsman started and the listed reserve candidates participated.

corrections: Benjamin Yurosek is not missing from the frozen registry: EA ID 4665 is present in the immutable Minnesota shard at OVR 62 and 0.0 Walters points.

Jaylan Ford and Lorenzo Styles Jr. were activated from Reserve/Injured on October 10 and played 20 and 15 special-teams snaps, respectively. The earlier statement that they remained unactivated for the game is retired.
Nathan Shepherd and Vernon Broughton were late illness additions and final inactives. Their absences require injury review; they cannot be treated as undesignated scratches.

The Friday wording that Ford and Styles remained on Reserve/Injured was true when published but was superseded by the October 10 activation. Activation plus final role review controls the game-day result.

caseReviews.baselineRationale: Bartholomew retains existing baseline duties and receives only Hockenson's added vacancy duty.
